experiment.claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "Output" row (1.8V +-2%, i.e. 1.764V-1.836V) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic landed by #14 (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch) under per-instance device mismatch, at a single representative operating point (nominal VIN=3.3V/27C/tt process corner, I_LOAD=1mA light load -- the same light-load convention sim/psrr-dc/ already uses). That row is DRAFT (issue #1 not yet ratified) -- the bound cited below is the DRAFT row's own window, not an invented final limit, and needs re-verification once #1 rules. This is a mismatch-only statistical check (klt sim's monte_carlo.vary="mismatch"): it re-runs this one PVT point N times with a fresh per-instance AGAUSS mismatch draw each time (sky130A's tt_mm .lib section -- see sim/README.md and docs/cli/sim.md in 2AMLogic/klayout-tools), NOT a re-run across the full PVT corner matrix (that is corner-run.py's separate job, e.g. sim/dropout-vs-load). Known-immature-design caveat (design/README.md "Known gaps"): C_COMP/C_CL remain unsized placeholders and the error amplifier still has a light-load/high-VIN output-swing ceiling, so a FAIL here is an honest, expected finding at this design stage, not a harness defect.
